claims: The 2026 Valero Texas Open is being held at TPC San Antonio's Oaks Course.
TPC San Antonio's Oaks Course is in San Antonio, Texas.
The Valero Texas Open takes place annually on TPC San Antonio's Oaks Course.
TPC San Antonio's Oaks Course is designed by Greg Norman.
TPC San Antonio's Oaks Course features a 72-par layout.
TPC San Antonio's Oaks Course has narrow, tree-lined fairways.
The Valero Texas Open is the final PGA Tour stop before the Masters Tournament.
